description: Records refused by the record and content rules (docs/spec.md sections 3.1, 4.6 and 5), each with its reason as the record of its kind, and what admission does with an output whose first field it is (section 8.1): skip one that claims no record, or refuse the transaction for the reason of the record the output claims (admissionClaims, admissionReason), which differs from kind and reason where the magic names the other record. Every one is decided by the record alone. Content cases carry a record that passes the record rules; their content breaks exactly one content rule, and every earlier content rule holds (signatures are valid for the altered document unless the case is a signature case).

refusals.name: envelope-too-large
refusals.note: over 20480 bytes: refused before it is decoded

refusals.name: envelope-not-canonical
refusals.note: created written with an eight-byte head

refusals.name: envelope-not-a-map
refusals.note: an array: claims nothing

refusals.name: envelope-65-keys
refusals.note: more than 64 keys, unknown ones included

refusals.name: envelope-text-key
refusals.note: a key that is not an unsigned integer

refusals.name: envelope-version-2
refusals.note: magic bbe 0x02: claims nothing this version reads

refusals.name: envelope-receipt-magic
refusals.note: a receipt's magic where an envelope's belongs: admission reads it as a receipt and refuses it for that

refusals.name: envelope-office-readable-only
refusals.note: the readable part alone never names an office

refusals.name: envelope-to-alias
refusals.note: 02 || p + 1, which go-sdk parses as the point with x = 1

refusals.name: envelope-expires-at-created
refusals.note: expires is zero or after created

refusals.name: envelope-content-16385
refusals.note: one byte over the content bound

refusals.name: envelope-content-text
refusals.note: content is a byte string, not a text string

refusals.name: content-array
refusals.note: a JSON array, not an object

refusals.name: content-white-space
refusals.note: the same object with a space: not its canonical serialization

refusals.name: content-duplicate-member
refusals.note: a member name given twice

refusals.name: content-fraction
refusals.note: numbers are integers only

refusals.name: content-lone-surrogate
refusals.note: an escaped lone surrogate

refusals.name: content-escaped-letter
refusals.note: an escape the canonical form never writes

refusals.name: content-version
refusals.note: metanetHandles other than 1.0

refusals.name: content-sender-mismatch
refusals.note: sender.identityKey is not the record's from

refusals.name: content-recipient-no-key
refusals.note: recipient without identityKey

refusals.name: content-recipient-handle-number
refusals.note: a recipient claim that is not a string

refusals.name: content-created-mismatch
refusals.note: created is not the record's created

refusals.name: content-created-offset
refusals.note: the same instant written with an offset: only YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ

refusals.name: content-payment-object
refusals.note: a payment in the clear: payment is null and a payment rides inside the encrypted content

refusals.name: content-cipher-truncated
refusals.note: base64 with its last character removed

refusals.name: content-cipher-short
refusals.note: 149 bytes: one under the shortest BRC-78 message

refusals.name: content-cipher-version-prose-order
refusals.note: version bytes 10 33 42 42, as the BRC-78 hex example writes them; go-sdk writes 42 42 10 33

refusals.name: content-cipher-wrong-recipient
refusals.note: a BRC-78 message the sender encrypted to itself

refusals.name: content-signature-identity-key
refusals.note: signed by the sender's identity key itself, as BRC-169 section 7.2 writes it; this contract signs under the derived signature key

refusals.name: content-signature-envelope-key
refusals.note: signed under the carrier's key id envelope, not signature

refusals.name: content-signature-recipient
refusals.note: signed by the recipient's signature key

refusals.name: content-signature-high-s
refusals.note: the valid signature with S replaced by n - S

refusals.name: content-signature-over-content
refusals.note: signed over the serialization with content included

refusals.name: receipt-acks-descending
refusals.note: acks are strictly ascending

refusals.name: receipt-acks-65
refusals.note: one over the most a receipt names

refusals.name: receipt-envelope-magic
refusals.note: an envelope's magic where a receipt's belongs: admission reads it as an envelope and refuses it for that
